author_scope: WACV constructive real-data follow-through; existing manuscript remains fallback. No external submission.
authorization: User already requested continued experiments and direct Claude debate. Both GPUs explicitly allowed in the active Claude tmux session; leave desktop memory headroom.
prospective_limit: Registered after existing MICrONS/control outcomes; future R outcomes and S real-label scores not examined at registration. Existing E1 tasks are already-examined, so this is exploratory generality, not fresh benchmark validation.
go_rule: Implementation and input/protocol hashes recorded after structural smoke. No R AllTest/far run or S real-label probe until that technical check. This is reproducibility review within existing user authorization, not a request for additional user permission.
question: Does the released neural-prediction interface become useful to the fixed servo when model time or state reset per game frame changes?
data: Existing RandomTrain V1-PPO trajectories, 6493 stored frames, two game instances, scan8-5 of one MICrONS mouse. Maze predictions are model outputs grounded in neural-training recordings, not measured neural responses to our game.

interface.continuous: carry state between game frames and trial boundaries
interface.frame_reset: restore identical gray-adapted state before each game frame
interface.game_clock: Server waits synchronously for an action; extra neural steps change model time per frame. Record wall-clock cost; do not call this additional game-action latency.
interface.response: last twin output after repeated view
interface.all_arms_receive: identical rendered frame stream during training collection; future closed-loop trajectories may diverge

replay_check.exclude: first kept trial of each instance, identically for new arms
replay_check.failure_action: Complete online re-collection of a continuous stream per instance with every candidate arm calculated on every actual game frame; no replay approximation is used for new heads if either required check fails.

heads.target: current lateral target offset on forward>0.5 rows within60degrees bearing
heads.placement_group: target/start positions, rounded exactly as existing mva_servo.placements
heads.selection: validation-placement MSE; all alpha scores retained; no AllTest tuning
heads.burn_in: same excluded first-trial rows for all new candidate heads
heads.reference_reuse_limit: Existing reference heads/runs use their original training rows and interface; disclose that they are historical context. Primary retiming contrasts use equally fitted new heads.
heads.encoder_only_secondary: Apply frozen rep3_cont head to each alternate encoder on training-build validation placements; report lateral prediction correlation and strafe agreement. This is offline and not a closed-loop dynamics causal test.

AllTest.conditions_reported: all available; prespecified tracking primary Normal and Fog

RandomTrainFar.warmup: existing V1 PPO policy, excluded from scored trials

statistics.cluster: actual target placements after checking per-instance trial identity and placement coverage across arms
statistics.slope: same one-unit-before-target lateral tracking definition as mva_failures.tracking_slope
statistics.pairing_check: Persist actual trial/placement keys; use same sampled placement multiplicities for both arms. If trajectories do not reach the slope evaluation point, record arm-specific inclusion and sensitivity; do not silently present those complete cases as an identical trial sample.
secondary: hit rate over every completed trial
statistics.multiplicity: All prespecified contrasts/conditions reported, no winner selection or population significance claim.

interpretation.positive: A direct positive contrast supports improved performance of the complete chosen interface under this controller and data collection. Separate heads make this an interface effect.
interpretation.negative: No benefit under tested interfaces; decoder capacity, fixed servo and train/test visual shift remain plausible explanations.
forbidden: significant arm vs nonsignificant arm treated as a difference
failure proved intrinsic to predicted neurons
pure dynamical mechanism from different heads

outputs_required: raw game logs with trial and placement identifiers
full head-selection traces and train/validation row IDs
every completed and incomplete trial outcome
